issue.title: test_agy_usage_probe_timeout_with_rate_limit_stderr_is_rate_limited fails under the loaded diff-scoped lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Observed 2026-09-25 at master ea25ee2bf plus an unrelated TUI diff in the sase_16 workspace. It failed once in a full diff-scoped 'just test-scoped' run (47440 passed, 6 failed, 33 min wall) and then passed when run alone with '-p no:xdist -p no:randomly'. Fail rate: 1 failure in 1 scoped-lane run; 0 failures in isolation. The failure depends on host load rather than the code under test, so this reproduces only in the parallel lane, not serially. It is a timeout-driven probe test, so a loaded host is the likely trigger.

payload.entry: CORRECTION: 'depends on host load rather than the code under test' is an inference from the pass-in-isolation result, not a measurement. The scoped run's failure output was not retained, so the failing assertion is unknown. It passed on a clean tree and on the modified tree when run alone.
